track.title: Homayoun
track.notes: Tagged title: Homayoun. Same performance as 'Setar' (2009) track 3; this transfer runs 0.65% slower than that one (onset alignment), about 11 cents lower if the speed carries the pitch.

album.title: The Masters of Persian Traditional Music, Sehtar (Instrumental)

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Phrase 1. Phrase 10 (2:21.1) introduces A, centred on F. Phrase 13 (2:58.2) introduces Bb, centred on Gk. Phrase 30 (6:12.2) introduces C, Db, centred on Bb. Phrase 33 (6:49.9) introduces As, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Bb4 (480.1 Hz) at 9:35.3. It closes on the tonic (F4 → F4 → F4 → Bb4 → F4 → F4).
